convert_got_ocr2_weights_to_hf: convert GOT-OCR2 model weights from original checkpoint format to Hugging Face transformers format
load_original_state_dict: load original GOT-OCR2 state dict from safetensors checkpoint files downloaded from a Hugging Face model hub
write_model: write converted GOT-OCR2 model weights, config, and perform a safety check reload to verify correctness
write_tokenizer: write GOT-OCR2 TikToken-based tokenizer with special tokens and chat template to a local directory
write_image_processor: write GOT-OCR2 image processor with resize, rescale, normalize settings to a local directory
